design: docs/one-to-one-completion-spec.md section 6, correction X1: ring 0 is the spine alone, everything it calls is bridged; the frontier is a COMPILE RANKING, not an N-doubling ladder; growth is bridged-calls-per-frame falling, not unit count rising

generated_from.chunks: research/decomp/ghidra-export/chunk_*.c (line ranges pinned by the registry)

frame_definition: one iteration of the spine's do{...}while(true) body at research/decomp/ghidra-export/chunk_0006.c:5790-5833; the capture's 16 iterations are 16 frames

root.ring0_decision: ring 0 is research/decomp/spine-boundary/ (the single-function module), NOT the queue unit auto-c0006-013.  auto-c0006-013 owns 2 of the spine's own loop callees (zz_0052838_, zz_00528b4_), so linking it makes those calls INTERNAL: the ledger would read 15 bridged calls per frame instead of the measured 17, and boundary_green could not be reproduced against it.  The queue unit is also status=pending -- never compiled -- so it is not an available artifact either.

graph_cross_check.note: scan_only edges are overwhelmingly calls to RENAMED functions, which the registry's external_callees never lists; registry_only edges are call sites the text scan could not see (function-pointer or macro forms)

monotonicity.finding: B is NOT maximal at ring 0.  Linking the units that own the spine's 17 loop callees replaces 17 crossings with those callees' own outbound calls, so B rises before it falls.  'bridged calls per frame falling' is a TERMINAL objective (B -> 0 iff the per-frame graph is closed), not a monotone greedy one; a rung must therefore be scored on NET and the ladder must accept rungs that raise B when they raise it by less than the static bound predicts.

estimator.edge_rate_rule: rate(f->g) = MEASURED per-frame count where a capture covers the edge, else freq(f) * static call sites (f->g)
estimator.freq_rule: freq(spine) = 1/frame by the frame definition; the spine's 19 direct callees are MEASURED (17 at 1.0/frame; 2 prologue calls at 0.0/frame -- they appear only in iteration 0 of the capture); deeper freq is STATIC, propagated along depth-increasing edges only, capped at depth 6
estimator.static_assumption: every call site in a body executes once per invocation: OVER-counts guarded calls, UNDER-counts calls in inner loops
estimator.sdk_calls: gnt4-* SDK callees (the registry's 996 sdk_prefix exclusions) are satisfied by the shim seed at link time, never bridged; they are not graph nodes and never count toward B

availability_summary.note: linkable_today means the unit has a green artifact in a tier the assembly gate links (oracle_green or compile_only).  An empty list means the whole frontier is uncompiled and the ranking is a COMPILE queue only -- no rung above ring 0 can be linked until the driver produces these units.
